## Specific task description

Task instruction: Position the smooth bowl with glossy finish at the center of the gray plate for dining.

Task description: Place the glossy blue-green bowl on the right of the initial view in the center of the gray plate near the lower middle.

Success criteria: The bowl is near the center of the gray plate and lowered onto it; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping an unobstructed bowl-wall section on the plate side, with one finger inside and one against the outer wall. Match the opening to local thickness and clearance rather than spanning the entire bowl diameter.
- Let the pads pass the thin rim and contact the inner and outer walls. Before closing, confirm the fingers actually enclose the bowl wall; during a slight lift, check for slipping rather than relying on image overlap alone.
- Keep the bowl opening upward during transport and leave clearance between its bottom and the raised edge of the plate, avoiding contact with the rim that could tilt it or make it fall during lateral movement.
- Adjust the bowl's position slightly toward the center of the plate, then lower slowly until supported before releasing. Avoid releasing it while suspended or letting a finger inside the bowl press against the plate.
